name: Boston University
feeMethod: Charges one full-time undergraduate tuition for every programme, so the calculator uses that rate for all bachelor's degrees. Master's degrees mostly pay the same flat full-time rate, except Engineering which bills per credit; the MD has its own published tuition.
description: Boston University is a private research university on the Charles River in Boston, Massachusetts, founded in 1839. It has 17 schools and colleges, including the Questrom School of Business, the College of Engineering and the Chobanian & Avedisian School of Medicine.
whyIncluded: Boston University has an active BU Alumni Association in Singapore that hosts local alumni events, and BU students can spend a semester on exchange at SMU. Its medical degree is recognised by the Singapore Medical Council for practice in Singapore.

livingCosts.summary: BU's own 9-month estimate for graduate students of room and board (shown together), books and incidentals. Tuition, fees and health insurance are extra.
livingCosts.notes: BU ISSO 'Graduate Estimate of Expenses - Charles River Campus' 2026/2027 (9-month I-20 estimate): Room and Board US$20,969 (combined, all under housing; food 0); personal = Books and Supplies US$1,313 + Incidentals US$4,992 = US$6,305; transport not listed separately (in incidentals). Financial Assistance's graduate cost of attendance uses Housing & Food US$16,250 and Incidentals US$4,412.

programmes.name: BS in Mechanical Engineering (College of Engineering)
programmes.feeBasis: BU's single 2026-27 full-time undergraduate tuition, charged for every programme, plus standard semester fees and the one-off orientation fee.
programmes.summary: Yearly tuition for BU undergraduates (one rate for all programmes) plus student services, community service and health and wellness fees. Health insurance not included; fees rise each year.
programmes.notes: BU Student Financials 'Tuition & Fees' 2026-2027: undergraduate full-time (fall & spring) tuition US$73,024. Compulsory = (Student Services Fee US$410 + Community Service Fee US$80 + Health & Wellness Fee US$295) per semester x 2 = US$1,570; Orientation Program Fee US$370 one-time. BU Student Health Insurance Plan (US$4,054 a year in 2026-27) excluded as it can be waived with comparable coverage. History from the same page's earlier-year tables: 2025-2026 tuition US$69,870, fees (US$392 + US$77 + US$282) x 2 = US$1,502, orientation US$355; 2024-2025 tuition US$66,670, fees (US$374 + US$73 + US$269) x 2 = US$1,432, orientation US$345. BU charges one undergraduate rate for all programmes. Not cohort-locked.

programmes.name: MS in Mechanical Engineering (College of Engineering)
programmes.feeBasis: BU Engineering's 2026-27 per-credit rate (US$2,282) times 32 credits, i.e. the whole MS taken in one year at 16 credits a semester.
programmes.summary: BU charges engineering master's per credit: shown for the 32-credit MS taken over two full-time semesters, plus mandatory fees. Health insurance not included.
programmes.notes: BU Financial Assistance 'Cost of Attendance for Graduate/Professional Schools' 2026/2027, College of Engineering (graduate): Tuition US$2,282/credit; Fees US$1,148. The Student Financials page confirms ENG on-campus master's students are billed per credit regardless of enrolment status. Annual figure = 16 credits per semester (four 4-credit courses) x 2 semesters = 32 credits x US$2,282 = US$73,024, i.e. the whole 32-credit MS in one academic year; students taking 12 credits a term pay less per year but study longer. BU Student Health Insurance Plan (US$4,054 a year in 2026-27) excluded as it can be waived with comparable coverage. History (read 2026-10-13) from BU Student Financials 'Tuition & Fees' earlier-year tables: the 2024-2025 and 2025-2026 tables do not have the 2026-27 note that ENG on-campus master's students are billed per credit, so they paid the full-time flat tuition (12-18 credits): US$69,870 (2025-26), US$66,670 (2024-25). The ENG graduate fee total for those years was not found (the tables give only the graduate Student Services Fee US$219/US$209 and Health & Wellness Fee US$282/US$269 per semester), so the rows carry tuition only and the current fees apply.

programmes.notes: BU Arts & Sciences 'Master's Tuition and Fees' 2026-2027: full-time (12-18 credits per semester) tuition US$36,512 per semester x 2 = US$73,024; Student Services Fee US$229 + Health & Wellness Fee US$295 per semester x 2 = US$1,048 (matches the Financial Assistance graduate cost of attendance). BU Student Health Insurance Plan (US$4,054 a year in 2026-27) excluded as it can be waived with comparable coverage. The MS is 32 credits, which fits two full-time semesters at the flat rate; some students take three. History (read 2026-10-13) from BU Student Financials 'Tuition & Fees' earlier-year tables: full-time tuition (all schools, 12-18 credits) 2025-2026 US$69,870, 2024-2025 US$66,670; full-time graduate Student Services Fee US$219/US$209 per semester + Health & Wellness Fee US$282/US$269 per semester, x 2 = US$1,002 (2025-26) and US$956 (2024-25).
